description: Introduction and overview of the Maserati 3500 GT (1957-1964): What this car is, its place in automotive history, and why collectors care. The Maserati 3500 GT was the company's first true production grand tourer, with a 3.5-liter racing-derived inline-six in Touring or Vignale coachwork. 2,226 were built, saving Maserati financially.
